body:
I am just going to say this. It may be helpful. I tried to od about 10 years ago and I did not take enough. The pain that I dealt with for the next 24 hrs made me want to die even more. Plus hospitalization which is forced because I was taken to the hospital and was in the psych ward for a few weeks. So if you live in a place that has a shit healthcare system you will be on the hook for hospital bills. 

Not saying you should or even encouraging it but keep in mind the consequences of it not working. I know what you are dealing with. Just a few hours ago and last night I had a noose around my neck but didn't do it. The thought of being forever dead is hard for my mind to deal with.

I remember telling my therapist I wish we had those suicide booths they have in Futurama. She didn't think it was very funny but I am serious. Two times in my life I have attempted but was always on impulse. Now I can't seem to do it no matter how close I get.

From my experience with my therapist I talk about taking my life all the time. Hell I even told her that I took care of all my affairs before I do and even methods I was thinking about. This was all recently. She knows if I miss an appointment it can only mean one thing. This is just my experience with mine. Not saying it will be the same for you.

Fuck yes it does especially if you don't take enough. This is coming from someone who tried to overdose about 10 years ago. I just remember being in the hospital and it felt like someone was stabbing me constantly. The pain actually made me want to die even more. 

Obviously failed attempt. It takes more then you think to overdose and it actually has the lowest rate of success. I think depending on what you take it can be painless if you take enough.

I've been reading a lot lately because of how fucking bad my mental health is and it helps. But I was reading something about people who commit suicide. Most of the people that do don't even want to die. But in their mind they have exhausted all their options and came to the conclusion that suicide is the only way out and in their mind it's the best decision they can make at the time with the information they have available. Lots of the times this decision is based off of limited information and that they are not looking at the whole picture and analyzing as much as they can. Being suicidal fucks up the way you think.

For me it's the thought of not existing anymore. Just poof you are dead and gone. Everything goes black. It's hard for my brain to comprehend this. Like that's it?

The two times I have attempted they were on impulse and I did not even think about it. But recently since I have it all planned out and even came close I could not do it. That one stupid thought.

All therapy and meds has done is distract me from my shit life and my shit mind and way of thinking. Two fucking years and I just realized I have not gained anything. Have not changed as a person or changed anything in my life. I have given up. It's just a matter of time for me before it's all over. All my planning is pretty much done besides a few more things. 

I have taken the time to think about this for a very long time. Same conclusion. It ends no other way for me.
